simple.meaning: אַפְּתֹם (ʼappᵉthôm) is a Hebrew word meaning “revenue ; others at the last.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
